The block splices the rc-write with a bare `;` inside the capture: `... 2>&1 ; echo \$? > /tmp/step9c-rc-issue-<N> & echo \$!`. Shell grammar parses this as three units: [pytest, FOREGROUND, all redirections bound to it] `;` [rc-write, backgrounded by the `&`] `;` [echo $!]. Consequences: (1) pytest runs foreground inside the inner shell, so the `PYTEST_PID=$( )` command substitution blocks for the full pytest wall and the Bash tool call is STILL killed at 600 s — the exact failure the plan exists to fix; (2) `\$!` captures the backgrounded rc-write's pid, not pytest's; (3) the rc file is written by a racing child before pytest exits — a garbage rc.
